name: Chicken Tikka Masala with Rice
method: Mix the chicken pieces with half the Greek yogurt, the curry powder and crushed garlic; leave for 15 minutes if you have time.
Fry the sliced onion in oil until soft, add the chicken and brown on all sides, then stir in the passata and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the remaining yogurt off the heat and serve over the cooked basmati rice.
